page.layout: One column of running text under the running head. No marginal notes. Section numbers (XXII., XXIII., XXIV., XXV.) stand alone on their own lines. Italic citations ("cap.32.", "cap.37.", "cap.41.", "ibidem.") close their paragraphs on the same line.

pit? cap.37.

rent. cap.41.

page.notes: No illegible words. Some spacing is irregular in the print (for example "esse,neq;", "obligent,quia"), and I have kept it. The printed hyphen at the end of the page ("maledi-") is kept because the word continues on the next page. Long s is written as plain s throughout, and u/v is normalised to the vowel/consonant forms.
